description: Puts a colored emoji or text badge before a thread's title, so you can spot status and topics in the sidebar at a glance. Tag a thread from the tag button in its hover controls, or create a tag there with up to 12 characters and a preset or custom color. An emoji picker lists every emoji by category and searches names in English and Russian, without network access. A Tags editor renames, recolors, and deletes tags, and the bb thread-tags command lets agents tag the thread they work in.
